name: building-frontends
title_zh: 改动任何前端界面时先问一句的守门员
tagline_zh: React/Next.js 里改组件、调样式、加 loading、动布局。
tagline_en: Before you touch React/Next.js components, styles, loading states, or data fetching, it flags i18n/RTL risks and.
desc_en: Use when building or changing any frontend UI — React or Next.js components, pages, forms, styling, loading states, scrollbars, client state, or data fetching — and when scaffolding a new frontend project, adding a shadcn/ui component, or touching i18n/RTL layout.
why_zh: 不是生成器，是检查员。在动手前扫描改动面，专挑那些你容易漏的国际化、滚动条、数据请求边界。
why_en: Not a generator—a reviewer. It scans your planned change for hidden breakage in internationalization, scrollbars, and fetch.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 React/Next.js 生态，不认 Vue/Svelte；只做改动前审查和脚手架建议，不产出完整代码。
limit_en: React/Next.js only; no Vue/Svelte. Pre-change review and scaffolding tips, not full code. Requires shadcn/ui or similar installed, else it just.
title_en: Frontend change gatekeeper that questions every UI edit
